snippet.title: Pioneers of Pagonia | Full Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The full release of Pioneers of Pagonia is out now! We are beyond excited for everyone to experience the full story campaign with the 1.0 release! See you in Pagonia!

Play now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2155180/Pioneers_of_Pagonia/

About the Game:
Rebuild hope in a world that was lost in the fog. Lead your Pioneers across the isles of Pagonia, unite scattered tribes, raise thriving communities and discover the history of your people as you reclaim your world in the new story campaign.

Find out more: https://pioneersofpagonia.com/index.php?lang=en-US

Join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/X9ChDjXEkr 
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/pioneersofpagonia 
Follow us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/pioneersofpagonia 
Follow us on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@pioneersofpagonia 
Follow us on Threads: https://www.threads.net/@pioneersofpagonia 
Follow us on BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/pioneersofpagonia.bsky.social 
Follow us on X: https://x.com/pagoniagame
